title: SEC4: agree_op.okm sized PUBKEY not OKM maxlen
description: In struct crypto2dev_agree_op (line 222), the okm field is sized CRYPTO2DEV_PUBKEY_MAXLEN (256) instead of CRYPTO2DEV_KDF_OKM_MAXLEN (64). No comment explains the intentional over-sizing. A maintainer writing code that reads or bounds-checks the okm output against CRYPTO2DEV_KDF_OKM_MAXLEN would either silently truncate or be confused about the true capacity. Either add a comment explaining why PUBKEY_MAXLEN is used (e.g., agreed-point size can exceed OKM size for large curves), or fix the field size to match its semantic purpose.
